messages:
Maya: quick triage scrub before handoff — queue: 42 open, 3 high, 1 blocker. quick notes below.
Liam: taking two highs (#40812, #40819). oncall until 18:00 PT. :+1:
Sam: blocker is the auth token rotation causing retry failures (see #40856). added reproducer steps and logs.
Nora: patched a macro to catch webhook duplicates — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/92  can someone review before I deploy?
Maya: @Nora can you paste the exact macro snippet here so we can eyeball it quickly?
Nora: snippet:
```
/macro payment_webhook_escalate "run /scripts/dedupe.py --id {{ticket.id}}; if duplicate -> escalate to billing; else tag 'needs-investigation'"
```
Liam: saw an automated alert from support-bot about embedding-service 5xx spike; auto ticket created (#40885). looks like a model shard OOM on large-batch embeddings.
Sam: I can rerun the failing batch with batch_size=32 and report back.
Maya: plan: Liam owns the payment duplicate flow, Sam owns embedding regressions, Nora finishes macro PR + deploy. ping #eng-oncall for infra blocks. handoff at 17:30 PT. :coffee:
support-bot: Auto: created ticket #40900 "webhook duplicate billing" from monitoring — assigned untriaged.
Nora: quick q — should macro include a `sleep 2` between retry attempts to reduce race? or prefer explicit dedupe check only?
Liam: prefer explicit dedupe check; sleeps are flaky. :100:
Sam: test run completed at 16:48 PT with smaller batch — embeddings succeeded, posting results to #eng-ml and ticket comment.
Maya: thanks — I'll update the shift doc and mark assignments. last check-in 16:56 PT.
